name: @gcu/proj
description: Coordinate reference systems for Sealed (offline, no-network) tools: proj4js vendored and pinned, the full EPSG table (every projected and geographic-2D CRS with a proj4 definition, names and areas of use) inflated on first use, published datum-shift overrides, a Natural Earth world outline, and transforms that state their path and accuracy.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
